source_text: Ongoing philosophical discourse questions whether communal benefits, such as reduced HIV transmission in high-prevalence areas (e.g., 60% efficacy in randomized trials from sub-Saharan Africa), justify non-consensual acts, though these are contested for applicability to low-risk infant contexts in developed nations.
